title: Overwhelmed!!!
text:
Overwhelmed!!!. Well, this unit weights a lot, but I think it is all glue. First, you can see the cheap particle board overlayed with a plastic veneer. But, that’s not the worst! This will take a whole day to put together. Seriously, I’m overwhelmed. And, I have put a lot of things together in my lifetime.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)

product_metadata.title: Qsun Rolling Kitchen Island with Wood Drop Leaf Tabletop, Kitchen Island Cart with Large Storage Cabinet, 3 Drawers, Towel Rack and Spice Rack on Wheels, Brown
features: [Plenty of Storage Options]The large rubber wood countertops, spacious storage cabinet and 3 storage drawers provide you with ample space to keep your belongings in order. The uniquely designed side vial rack and side detachable towel rack can conveniently place small jars and vials, as well as towels. In addition, the drawer is equipped with sliding rails for easy use.

[Adjustable Shelves and Drop Leaf Countertop] Adjustable shelves in the kitchen island trolley can better plan the storage space for you and make the kitchen tidy and beautiful. The drop leaf makes the countertop expandable and you can use it as a dining table or bar table.

[Wheels for Easy Mobility] The kitchen island cart equipment with four 360° smooth-rolling wheels which provides effortless mobility. Equipment with two lockable wheels, you can also stop anywhere at will by just stepping on the brake.

[Solid & Sturdy Kitchen Cart] The high-quality engineered board and rubber wood table top add the advantages of durability and stability to this kitchen cart to last for long years with longer lifespan. Three tripods support the fallen leaves table top, the main table top has a high capacity of 135 pounds.

[Simple Assembly Required] This kitchen island cart comes with step-by-step assembly instructions and numbered parts and hardware to make sure you can set up it without difficulties. or your convenience, the necessary installation tool is also included.
